description:
**Features:**

- Custom model and textures

- Support for all quality settings
- Custom Voice-over for all languages
- New VFX
- Custom loading screen and in-game icons
- Your Eternal, Galactic Empire
- The inting is going according to plan
- Unlimited Power!


Now, you will experience the full power of the Dark Side... delivered on the Summoner's Rift by non other than Emperor Palpatine himself! 
New model, some modified animations, including a recall befitting of a Sith Lord, new, themed VFX, including force lightning, imperial probe droids, and an avatar of Darth Bane on ulti. It also included new sounds, and Palpatine's voice. Enjoy!
